map.📖 查看「NT-proBNP(心衰)截断值评估器 使用指南」: View the NT-proBNP (Heart Failure) Cutoff Assessor Guide
map.提示：NT-proBNP受年龄、肾功能、肥胖、房颤影响。CKD(eGFR<60): Note: NT-proBNP is affected by age, renal function, obesity and atrial fibrillation. CKD (eGFR<60) can raise it 2-3x, obesity lowers it ~20%, and AF raises it ~30%. NT-proBNP has a longer half-life than BNP (120 min vs 20 min), more stable. A pre-discharge drop >=30% indicates effective treatment. For clinical reference only.
map.年龄分层截断值：NT-proBNP 排除心衰阈值随年龄升（一般 <50 岁 <1: Age-stratified cutoffs: The NT-proBNP rule-out threshold rises with age (generally <50 y <125 pg/ml, 50-75 y <300, >75 y <450, varying slightly by guideline), used to exclude acute HF.
map.灰区解读：介于排除与确诊截断之间提示非心源性或轻度心衰/房颤/高龄/肾损，需结合: Gray-zone interpretation: Values between rule-out and rule-in suggest non-cardiac causes or mild HF / AF / advanced age / renal impairment, needing clinical and echocardiographic correlation.
map.诊断与随访：值越高心衰可能性越大；治疗后下降提示容量与负荷改善，动态变化比单次更: Diagnosis and follow-up: Higher values mean greater HF likelihood; a post-treatment drop indicates improved volume and load - trends matter more than a single value.
map.输入：女、78 岁、NT-proBNP 520 pg/ml、伴气促、无肾衰。工具: Inputs: Female, 78 y, NT-proBNP 520 pg/ml, with dyspnea, no renal failure. Output: Age cutoff (>75 y) 450, Result Above rule-out, Note HF cannot be excluded (upper gray zone), Advice Combine echo EF and clinical, Caution Renal impact. Note: BNP affected by age / kidney / obesity.
map.NT-proBNP 随年龄升高、肾功下降也升、肥胖者偏低，故指南按年龄设排除阈值: NT-proBNP rises with age and falling renal function, and is lower in obesity, so guidelines set age-based rule-out thresholds (e.g. <50 / <300 / <450 pg/ml) to improve sensitivity; above cutoff only suggests further work-up, not confirmation.
map.值在灰区说明什么？: What does a value in the gray zone mean?
map.灰区（排除与确诊之间）常见于非心因气促、房颤、肺部感染、肾损或轻度心衰，不能单凭: The gray zone (between rule-out and rule-in) commonly reflects non-cardiac dyspnea, AF, pulmonary infection, renal impairment or mild HF; it cannot be judged by number alone and needs symptoms, chest X-ray, echo and trends.
map.治疗后下降代表好转吗？: Does a post-treatment drop mean improvement?
map.多数急性心衰有效利尿/扩管后 NT-proBNP 下降提示容量与心室负荷改善，下: After effective diuresis / vasodilation in most acute HF, a falling NT-proBNP indicates improved volume and ventricular load, and the drop magnitude correlates with prognosis; but a single value is confounded by many factors, so dynamic follow-up is more valuable.
